params.name: dataTypeName
params.description: The type of data to export. Supported types include emailSend, emailOpen, emailClick, emailUnSubscribe, emailBounce, emailComplaint, pushSend, pushBounce, pushOpen, smsSend, smsBounce, smsReceived, inAppSend, inAppOpen, inAppClick, webPushSend, purchase, customEvent, and hostedUnsubscribeClick.

params.name: startDateTime
params.description: Start of the export date range in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z)

params.name: endDateTime
params.description: End of the export date range in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2024-01-31T23:59:59Z)

params.name: range
params.description: Predefined date range to export. Use instead of startDateTime and endDateTime for convenience. Options include Today, Yesterday, BeforeToday, and All.

params.name: omitFields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to exclude from the export

params.name: onlyFields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the export. When specified, only these fields are returned.

items.docs: Exports event data from the Iterable project in JSON format. Supports filtering by date range and data type. The response is a stream of newline-delimited JSON objects, each representing a single event record.

info.name: Export events for a specific user

params.name: email
params.description: Email address of the user whose events to export

params.name: includeCustomEvents
params.description: Whether to include custom events in the export

items.docs: Exports all tracked events for a specific user identified by email address. Returns events in JSON format with support for pagination and filtering by event type.
